rules.git: git+, git:, github:, and #semver: specs are rejected; runtime deliverables are registry literals only
rules.url: http and https tarball URL specs are rejected
rules.file: file: specs are build-time-only, not a runtime deliverable form
rules.range: semver ranges, wildcards, x-ranges, and comparator sets are rejected
rules.dist-tag: dist-tags such as latest are rejected
rules.missing-version: a package name without an exact x.y.z version is rejected
rules.wrong-package: only the fixed bootstrap package name is accepted
rules.version-mismatch: an exact x.y.z literal that is not the recorded fixed version is rejected
rules.spec-type: a package spec must be a non-empty string

invocationRules.argv-type: argv must be a non-empty array of plain strings
invocationRules.missing-bin: every invocation must name the fixed bin csm-skills-bootstrap after the package flags
invocationRules.shell: no shell strings, pipes, redirections, or fallback commands are permitted in argv
invocationRules.extra-flags: flags beyond the required, offline, and documented subcommand sets are rejected

notes: offline is cache-warmed only: npx --offline --no replays a previously verified warm invocation and fails closed when the required bytes are absent, with no network fallback
the npx cache is not durable or portable (D6): offline support is conditional on a verified warm cache plus recorded node/npm/platform metadata in the cache manifest

real-registry offline replay is deferred to the release stage because publication is deferred (D8): first-release offline validation runs at the packed-artifact plus manifest layer against an isolated cache
